summary: Verified fix to GuestSessionPage SimPhase — after simulation completion, the real simulation component now stays mounted while a 'Simulation Complete' banner (data-testid='sim-result') is layered above. Tested end-to-end for both document-type and excel-type free sessions using localStorage presets to jump to Simulation tab. All acceptance criteria pass, including the previously-untested downstream navigation via 'sim-continue-btn'.

issues: Sticky page header (course title + 'FREE SESSION 1 of 2') visually overlaps with the sim hints panel text at the top of the scrolled view — appears as translucent overlay. Cosmetic, not blocking. Pre-existing, not caused by this fix.

excel_sim_flow.note: After completing excel sim (session 2 in this browser context), Continue navigated to the other still-incomplete free session (18bfb490) rather than paywall — expected, since only b5b21761 had localStorage complete flags set in this fresh session.

console_warnings_observed: Univer spreadsheet emits a React warning on unmount: 'Attempted to synchronously unmount a root while React was already rendering.' Non-blocking, pre-existing in UniverSpreadsheet unmount path — not caused by this fix. Consider wrapping unmount in queueMicrotask / setTimeout(0) if it ever surfaces as a real issue.
critical_code_review_comments: SimPhase implementation is clean: keeps the sim component mounted after isDone by only layering a banner above (lines ~378-420 of GuestSessionPage.jsx). Correctly preserves per-task feedback state in DocumentSim and the SolutionReveal state in UniverSpreadsheet.

The 'No simulation' fallback path (line 358-366) correctly branches its Continue button based on isDone → uses onAdvance when done, onComplete otherwise. Cannot easily test at runtime because both current free sessions have has_simulation=true; noted in review request as OK to skip.
seed_data_creation: none — used localStorage presets vv_guest_sess_<sessionId> = {videoWatched:true, notesComplete:true, quizComplete:true, quizScore:80} to jump to Simulation phase, per review request instructions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: GuestSessionPage.jsx SimPhase fix (iteration 73) is verified for both document and excel sim types including full downstream 'sim-continue-btn' navigation. Prior fixes in iteration 71 (sim rendering mapping + quiz auto-advance) and iteration 72 (Admin Courses tab + hero CTA + paywall count) are also stable. No regressions detected.
